title: God's Covenant with Abraham
reflectionText: He was ninety-nine when the promise came, and he fell on his face and laughed — a hundred years old, and Sarah ninety. Then he asked for Ishmael instead. God blessed Ishmael and kept Isaac in the covenant anyway. What is it to be given what your own arithmetic says cannot happen?
